title: Split maps between cone terms
statement: In a preadditive category with binary biproducts [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], a commuting square of cochain maps induces a mapping-cone map. If its domain component in degree i+1 and codomain component in degree i are split monic, then the cone map in degree i is split monic.

proof.text: Use the cone-term isomorphism with the biproduct of the shifted domain term and the codomain term. Define the retraction as the biproduct of the two chosen retractions, conjugated by these cone-term isomorphisms. Check the left inverse on the two cone injections using the mappingCone.map formulas.

lean.statement:
lemma cone_map_split
    {A : Type*} [Category* A] [Preadditive A] [HasBinaryBiproducts A]
    {K L K' L' : CochainComplex A ℤ} (d : K ⟶ L) (d' : K' ⟶ L')
    (a : K ⟶ K') (b : L ⟶ L') (h : d ≫ b = a ≫ d') (i : ℤ)
    [IsSplitMono (a.f (i + 1))] [IsSplitMono (b.f i)] :
    IsSplitMono ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.map d d' a b h).f i)
